name: dsh-ungrouped-sweeper
description: Sweep the dsh web conversation list: a standalone page lists stored sessions by workspace, batch-archives the ungrouped test ones through the official workspace registry (stops running work first), and restores them anytime. 会话清扫器：按分组列出对话，一键归档未分组的测试对话（走官方注册表、先停运行任务），随时恢复。
